reviews.conclusion: A long bastion-to-End bracket contains several brief settings screens, portal transitions, and narrow/obscured game captures. At 1 fps, four isolated menu samples bound combined menu exposure only between 0 and 8 s. The -4.4333 s deficit is not exactly resolved; hidden pause state and undersampling prevent a strong timing conclusion. No suspicious splice is established.

The completed End fight leads through a black exit transition at proxy 4-5.25 s into overworld respawn. Game-menu/Open to LAN screens are visible at 9.25-11.25 s. These are ordinary post-run actions. Their combined visible-state bounds are 3.25-4.25 s, but Open to LAN can change pause behavior, so this does not establish exact closure of the 3.667 s GUI deficit.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
